facts.fact: The APDPVP cites law n°025/2023 of 12 July 2023 amending law n°001/2011 of 25 September 2011 on personal data protection as the Gabonese legal framework.
facts.system: Law n°001/2011 as amended by law n°025/2023

facts.fact: The APDPVP, an independent administrative authority led by president Joël Dominique Ledaga, held a working session on 9 June 2026 and says it oversees the rules on collecting, processing, storing and securing data.
